entries.mechanic: A weapon's attack rate: the attack time in integer milliseconds, floored after local increased attack speed, rate 1000 / ms (Q11); PoB rounds the base rate and the local rate to two decimals. The registered value also carries the skill's attack speed multiplier and global modifiers in PoB's order; it holds only if open question Q12 confirms that order.
evidence: In-game weapon tooltip, maintainer, 2026-11-12: Siege Axe (667 ms) with 15% increased attack speed shows 1.72; PoB's model gives round(1.50 x 1.15, 2) = 1.73. It shows the weapon's own rate only, and does not separate a floored from an unfloored attack time (both 1.7241) (docs/phase-3/attack-hits.md, "The switch")

Mark_GGG, Reddit questions thread 2020-01-29: weapons have an attack time in ms; 625 / 1.23 = 508 ms, rounded down to an integer value; attacks per second 1000 / ms, rounded only for the tooltip (https://devtrackers.gg/pathofexile/p/bc0f1173-questions-thread-january-29-2020)

This fixture's weapon has no local attack speed: the difference is the base rate 1000 / 667 = 1.4993 against PoB's exported round(1000 / 667, 2) = 1.50, supported by the tooltip (not PoB's 1.50 x 1.15) and the developer's 1000 / ms
